domains.objective: Turn queue pressure into deterministic admission and routing signals without creating a second scheduler.
Damp oscillation under burst load with bounded backpressure, hysteresis, and fair recovery.
Detect unstable retry, cancellation, and queue interactions before they amplify across Cells.
Rebalance stranded capacity without violating Cell ownership, epoch fencing, or Airflow authority.
Define explicit trust and capacity boundaries at intake, provider, tenant, and execution edges.
Conserve durable work identity across retries, sandbox replacement, takeover, and publication.
Account for work, evidence, artifacts, cost, and external mutations as observable flow across boundaries.
Switch control behavior predictably between laminar, pressured, turbulent, and choked operating regimes.
Stop retry storms caused by ambiguous external results, transient provider loss, and stale observations.
Propagate state changes and wakeups without duplicate scheduling, event storms, or hidden mutation authority.
Exploit local reuse and warm execution while preserving correctness, tenant isolation, and eviction evidence.
Continuously collapse duplicate abstractions, dead branches, stale state, and stabilization debt.

concerns.name: canonical invariant
concerns.slice: Define stable identities, units, ownership, and a machine-checkable invariant.

concerns.name: durable persistence
concerns.slice: Persist the control state crash-safely with explicit schema/version migration semantics.

concerns.name: versioned API
concerns.slice: Expose the signal and decision through a versioned backend contract with deterministic refusal.

concerns.name: Airflow runtime integration
concerns.slice: Integrate the control signal into Airflow-owned lifecycle orchestration without delegated scheduling.

concerns.name: operator surface
concerns.slice: Expose deterministic CLI/TUI inspection, explanation, and repair actions.

concerns.name: security boundary
concerns.slice: Apply least privilege, tenant isolation, trust-zone checks, and fail-closed policy behavior.

concerns.name: failure recovery
concerns.slice: Specify cancellation, stale-writer, retry, timeout, ambiguous-result, and restart behavior.

concerns.name: scale pressure
concerns.slice: Bound queues, concurrency, fairness, hysteresis, and overload behavior under sustained pressure.

concerns.name: evidence and SLO
concerns.slice: Record signals, decisions, latency, cost, refusals, and repair outcomes as retained evidence.

concerns.name: entropy collapse
concerns.slice: Provide E2E stabilization that deletes superseded control paths and proves one surviving authority.
